video.title: AI欧腐《溺于水中的爱/Drowning Love》
video.desc:
Elvis, a CEO suffering from severe insomnia amid a US conglomerate power struggle, disguises himself as a part-time swim coach to get close to Amber, a broke, pale college student who lost his memory to PTSD after saving Elvis by firing a gun at twelve. With a wealthy childhood friend constantly stirring things up and the charged push-and-pull in the pool, the two complete a fated mutual redemption.
Elvis 是一位深陷美国财团权力斗争、饱受严重失眠折磨的 CEO。他伪装成兼职游泳教练，只为接近 Amber——一个穷困、苍白的大学生。十二岁那年，Amber 曾开枪救下 Elvis，却因创伤后应激障碍失去了记忆。
一个富家发小不断从中搅局，泳池里的拉扯暗流涌动，两人最终完成了一场命中注定的彼此救赎。
